title: Irish Beetroot Hash
description: A lacto-vegetarian-friendly, crispy, Irish dish featuring beetroot, perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Using a mandoline, slice the beetroot and potatoes into thin strips, similar to katsuramuki-cut.
Add the beetroot and potato strips to the pan, stirring to coat with oil and combine with onions and garlic.
Sprinkle the caraway seeds over the top and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix together the all-purpose flour and kefir.
Pour the flour-kefir mixture over the beetroot and potato mixture, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is crispy and golden brown.
Stir in the chopped chives and cook for a final minute.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
